citation.verbatim: The Amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on June 7, 2024. Exhibit 3.1: At the Effective Time, each share of Common Stock issued as of immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically subdivided and reclassified into ten (10) validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable shares of Common Stock. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on June 10, 2024.

D1.decision: Effectuate the mandatory 10-for-1 split under the June 7 effectiveness 8-K using the 18,000-share eligible position; maintain the already split-adjusted PCF at 1,800 shares per creation unit and confirm 180,000 shares as of June 7. No election is available or required. Hold only the June dividend net-cash receivable pending withholding documentation.

actions.action: update PCF NVDA quantity per creation unit to 1,800
escalate and hold: Book only the net NVDA dividend cash receivable payable 2024-06-28; split PCF and position processing may proceed.
actions.note: missing document: MEGA account tax-status and applicable NVDA dividend withholding-rate documentation

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The dividend is separately governed by nvda-8k-20240522. Gross cash is 180,000 projected shares on the 2024-06-11 dividend record date multiplied by the $0.01 post-split rate, equaling $1,800. Net cash cannot be determined because the store lacks the specific MEGA account tax-status and applicable NVDA dividend withholding-rate documentation. This missing documentation was escalated, and only the net dividend receivable payable 2024-06-28 is held.
